name: talking-head-editor
why: The most complete single playbook for a person speaking to camera: DeepFilterNet voice cleanup capped so it never sounds robotic, match-EQ and -14 LUFS loudness, pause-separated transcription so retakes are never merged, cuts that wait for the real word end, reframing and punch-ins, word-timed captions, and motion graphics written as code (cine.js scene kit, three worked examples, a motion standard).
caveats: scripts/setup.sh builds a .venv with whisper, DeepFilterNet and OpenCV — a large install; those model downloads are blocked here, so only the ffmpeg/node parts of the pipeline run in this sandbox.
Motion-graphics rendering uses HyperFrames + node, which are installed; targets 16:9 by default.
docs/ (site build) was dropped from the vendored copy; mg/, scripts/ and references/ are intact.
